req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to verify that the task update functionality correctly persists changes and handles various edge cases, including successful updates, invalid updates, and boundary conditions. The tests ensure that the system behaves as expected according to the requirement statement, covering both positive and negative scenarios.

tests.name: test_update_task_success
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with ID 1.
expected: The response payload reflects the updated task details.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Update the task
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Expected: Verify the task was updated
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_task_not_found
preconditions: No task with ID 9999 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update a non-existent task with ID 9999.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/9999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False})

# Expected: Verify the response indicates the task was not found
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 9999 not found" in update_response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with ID 1 using the maximum allowed title length.
expected: The response payload reflects the updated task with the maximum title length.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Action: Update the task with maximum title length
max_length_title = "T" * 100
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary Test Description", "completed": False})

# Expected: Verify the task was updated with the maximum title length
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['title'] == max_length_title
assert updated_task['description'] == "Boundary Test Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
